+++ pom.xml

+<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>

+         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"

+            <scope>test</scope>

+    <build>
+        <plugins>

+            <plugin>

parts.text:
Maven JSON project is set up and verified.

Structure:
- `pom.xml` — Java 21, Jackson `databind` 2.22.3, JUnit 6.1.3, exec plugin
- `src/main/java/com/example/json/App.java:1` — serialize, deserialize, and pretty-print via `ObjectMapper`
- `src/main/java/com/example/json/Person.java:1` — sample record
- `src/test/java/com/example/json/AppTest.java:1` — round-trip tests
- `.gitignore`

Run with `mvn test` or `mvn exec:java`. Jackson's `ObjectMapper` handles both POJO mapping (`writeValueAsString`/`readValue`) and raw tree parsing (`readTree`). Note: I bumped the pom to the newest dependency versions the build flagged.
